title: customeraddress
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, parentid_account, parentid_contact, transactioncurrencyid.

addressnumber.description: Shows the number of the address, to indicate whether the address is the primary, secondary, or other address for the customer.

addresstypecode.description: Select the address type, such as primary or billing.

city.description: Type the city for the customer's address to help identify the location.

country.description: Type the country or region for the customer's address.

county.description: Type the county for the customer's address.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

customeraddressid.description: Unique identifier of the customer address.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

fax.description: Type the fax number associated with the customer's address.

freighttermscode.description: Select the freight terms to make sure shipping charges are processed correctly.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

latitude.description: Type the latitude value for the customer's address, for use in mapping and other applications.

line1.description: Type the first line of the customer's address to help identify the location.

line2.description: Type the second line of the customer's address.

line3.description: Type the third line of the customer's address.

longitude.description: Type the longitude value for the customer's address, for use in mapping and other applications.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the customer's address, such as Corporate Headquarters.

objecttypecode.description: Shows the type code of the customer record to indicate whether the address belongs to a customer account or contact.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

postalcode.description: Type the ZIP Code or postal code for the address.

postofficebox.description: Type the post office box number of the customer's address.

primarycontactname.description: Type the name of the primary contact person for the customer's address.

shippingmethodcode.description: Select a shipping method for deliveries sent to this address.

stateorprovince.description: Type the state or province of the customer's address.

telephone1.description: Type the primary phone number for the customer's address.

telephone2.description: Type a second phone number for the customer's address.

telephone3.description: Type a third phone number for the customer's address.

upszone.description: Type the UPS zone of the customer's address to make sure shipping charges are calculated correctly and deliveries are made promptly, if shi…

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

utcoffset.description: Select the time zone for the address.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the customer address.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
